label: 1FINITY T600 transport blade
description: 1RU disaggregated DCI transponder/muxponder blade with two pluggable PIUs, 2.4 Tb/s per blade and software-provisioned line rates from 200G to 600G on a single wavelength. Modelled fully equipped: 24x 100GbE QSFP28 client ports (12 per PIU) and 4x fixed coherent line ports at 200G-600G, modelled at this engine's 100G ceiling.
